pages.text: Each recipe below also needs exactly one Taglock bound to the intended online player. Insert each listed item separately, including repeated ingredients. Item order does not matter. Use Flint and Steel after all offerings are inserted.

pages.title: conflagration
pages.text: fiery unguent, crops hellebore (tag), bottled hellfire, charcoal. Add one bound Taglock.

pages.title: darkness
pages.text: oil of vitriol, oak apple gall, iron gall ink, belladonna, aconitum. Add one bound Taglock.
